lede: I'm a product strategist and builder who turns ambitious ideas into tangible results — from MVP to enterprise scale.
intro: I'm Principal Strategy Consultant at Modea, where I built the strategy practice and now lead it alongside the consulting arm of their software agency. I'm also the founder of SINSA, an AI consulting company that builds systems meant for production rather than for a pitch deck, and co-founder of YO, a GenAI platform for personalized interactive stories. Before this I built products at SourceFuse, PayPal, Relief Financial, People Rocket, Cognizant, and Dominion Enterprises.
throughLine: I work at the intersection of design, technology, and business. It isn't about making things look good — it's about building systems that work, solving real problems for real people, and creating experiences that feel less like software and more like well-crafted tools. I thrive in the space between a rough idea and a polished product.
sideWork: I've also been building the web for over 20 years. It started with customizing MySpace pages in HTML and CSS and turned into more than 150 websites as a freelance developer — work that has run alongside every job I've held, and where most of the product instincts came from.
current: I take on a small number of strategic engagements each year, and I'm available for new work in 2026.
footerBio: Builder, creator, problem solver. Twenty years turning ambiguous ideas into things people actually use.
bioThirdPerson: Max Murphy is a product strategist, architect, and builder with more than 12 years of experience shipping products from MVP to enterprise scale. He is Principal Strategy Consultant at Modea, where he built the strategy practice and leads the consulting arm of its software agency, and the founder of SINSA, an AI consulting company. He is also co-founder of the GenAI storytelling platform YO. He previously founded CraniumTap Research, a survey analytics SaaS acquired by Tribune Publishing in 2021, and built products at SourceFuse, PayPal, Relief Financial, People Rocket, Cognizant, and Dominion Enterprises. He has also worked as a freelance web developer for over 20 years, building more than 150 websites alongside his product career.
sectionHeadline: A decade of shipping the work across fintech, enterprise, and AI-native products.
sectionIntro: Product strategy engagements across enterprise platforms, editorial systems, and AI-native products — each anchored by the same approach: integrate hard and soft data into every plan, then iterate toward something real.
